title: Enhanced Curriculum Structure for Higher Nitec Certification and Help for Students who may Struggle
what_it_is: Enhanced Curriculum Structure for Higher Nitec Certification and Help for Students who may Struggle

sections.label: Enhanced three-year ITE structure
sections.summary: The enhanced three-year structure aims for more students to continue to a third year and attain a Higher Nitec instead of leaving after two-year Nitec certification.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: With the enhanced three-year structure, we hope that more students can continue on to a third year and attain a Higher Nitec, instead of leaving after the two-year Nitec certification.

sections.label: ITE early student support
sections.summary: ITE will regularly engage students and identify those needing more support early based on class participation, engagement, assessment performance and other factors.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: First, ITE will continue to proactively and regularly engage its students and identify those who may need more support early based on their class participation, engagement level, performance in assessments and other relevant factors.

sections.label: Flexible pathway for modules
sections.summary: ITE will support students wanting more time with a flexible pathway taking a lower module load and additional semesters to complete.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For those who would like more time to complete their modules, ITE will support them with a more flexible pathway to take a lower load of modules and take additional semesters to complete.

sections.label: Industrial attachments reinforce learning
sections.summary: Industrial attachments in Year Two and Year Three will reinforce classroom learning and help students appreciate its applicability.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The industrial attachments planned for both Year Two and Year Three will help to reinforce and strengthen what they learn in the classroom and help them appreciate the applicability of what they are learning.

sections.label: Nitec exit and return support
sections.summary: Students can exit with a Nitec qualification and transcript, receive job placement support and guidance, and return to ITE to complete modules and attain Higher Nitec.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Students can still choose to exit with a Nitec qualification and transcript reflecting modules that they have already completed.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: ITE will also provide job placement support to help them with their transition to work, as well as customised education and career guidance.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The goal is to encourage and support them to return to ITE anytime they choose to do so, to complete the rest of the modules and attain their Higher Nitec qualification, either through the full-time or part-time programmes.

sections.label: Polytechnic diploma pathway places
sections.summary: Polytechnic diploma programmes are one pathway and places will continue to be set aside for them.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: The diploma programmes offered by the polytechnics is one of the pathways and there will continue to be places that will be set aside for them.
